name: word-in-context
title: Word in Context
description: Save curious words together with the sentence you read them in, and review them casually
author: diskun00

commands.name: capture
commands.title: Capture Word
commands.subtitle: Word in Context
commands.description: Pick a word from the selected sentence or paragraph and save it with its context

commands.name: browse
commands.title: Browse Words
commands.subtitle: Word in Context
commands.description: Browse saved words, their definitions and the sentences you found them in

commands.name: review
commands.title: Casual Review
commands.subtitle: Word in Context
commands.description: Guess a few saved words from their context sentences, no schedule

preferences.name: markdownPath
preferences.title: Markdown File
preferences.description: Optional. Every captured word is also appended to this file, e.g. ~/Notes/Vocabulary.md

preferences.name: minWordLength
preferences.title: Minimum Word Length
preferences.description: Shorter words are hidden from the capture list

preferences.name: autoExplain
preferences.title: AI Explanation
preferences.label: Explain words in context with Raycast AI automatically
preferences.description: Requires Raycast Pro. When off, use the Explain in This Sentence action

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
